bios.short: Julian R. Moreau, M.T.S., is a Catholic speaker, retreat leader, and pastoral facilitator based in New Orleans, Louisiana. He holds a Master of Theological Studies from Notre Dame Seminary and has served parishes, dioceses, and schools across the United States for over 16 years, preaching on Eucharistic renewal, sacramental imagination, and apostolic discipleship.
bios.medium: Julian R. Moreau, M.T.S., is a Catholic evangelist, retreat master, and diocesan consultant rooted in the historic spiritual heritage of New Orleans, Louisiana. Holding a Master of Theological Studies (Summa Cum Laude) in Systematic Theology from Notre Dame Seminary, Julian combines intellectual orthodoxy with warm Southern storytelling. Over the past sixteen years, he has keynoted over 180 parish missions, diocesan assemblies, and Catholic school convocations nationwide, guiding communities toward vibrant sacramental faith and apostolic mission.
bios.long: Julian R. Moreau, M.T.S., is a nationally recognized Catholic speaker, retreat director, and pastoral facilitator based in New Orleans, Louisiana. Formed in classical philosophy and Catholic theology at Loyola University and Notre Dame Seminary, Julian earned his Master of Theological Studies with highest honors, specializing in Sacramental Ecclesiology and St. Augustine. Having served as a parish director of evangelization, high school campus minister, and strategic consultant, he brings grounded realism and liturgical reverence to every engagement. Julian has led parish missions, diocesan assemblies, and clergy days across 42 dioceses. He resides in New Orleans with his wife Claire and their four children.
